name: Mr. Ashford
appearance: A composed, well-dressed gentleman of settled means, agreeable features and correct, unremarkable manners.
definition: A gentleman of comfortable property and unimpeachable respectability — sensible, courteous, and just a little dull. The sort the neighbourhood approves of without quite remembering afterward.
voice: Correct and even-tempered, courteous without warmth; he speaks in the safe, agreeable phrases of good society.
